This update is notable for adding [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. This update encompassed five versions, the main v2.4.0 update (released 31 July 2026) and three minor updates, the v2.4.1 (released 31 July 2026), v2.4.2 (released 31 July 2026), v2.4.2a (released 2 August 2026). and v2.4.3 (released 7 August 2026). ==Additions== ===Maps=== *[[Severing Connection]] *[[Abandoned City (Story Mode)]] *TEMP_Grasslands ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Story Mode|Story]] mode 0.16. ****Coordination radius decreased from +0 to -0.75. *[[Tutorial]]'s former mode has been removed and incorporated into [[Story Mode|Story]] mode as chapter 0. *New [[Main Lobby]]. **Updated appearance. **Survival [[Elevators]] are now split into six groups of two [[Elevators]], each group for a specific mode. These also do not have maps in them but instead send the player to the [[Survival Intermission Lobby]]. **Extra area replaced with a chill area, making [[Challenge Trials]] and [[PVP]] entirely [[Matchmaking]] based with no section of the [[Main Lobby]] for them. **Added a [[Story Mode|Story]] mode area. **Added a few balls around the spawn area. **Expanded [[Backrooms]]. *[[Tutorial]] remade. *Updated cutscene and dialogue systems for better story sequences, speaker presentation, subtitles, timing and debugging tool. *Updated [[Matchmaking]] UI. *Updated tower information UI. *Updated the descriptions in [[Codes]]. *[[Pizza Party]] lighting changed. *[[Polluted Wasteland II]] is now brighter. *[[Night Station]] is now brighter. *[[Derelict Outpost]] no longer has a fog. *Tracked [[Quests]] and [[Mission Quests]] now display the current objective for quests with more than one objective. *[[Settings]] no longer allows to replay the [[Tutorial]], as this has been incorporated into [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. *The [[Elementalist]] now prevents the [[Ice Turret]] from freezing the enemy it is attacking. *Fixed [[Ranger]]'s explosion having infinite max hits. *Fixed '''🇺🇸 Rise for the Pledge!''', '''Dark Radiance''', '''For the Commander!''', '''T.D.S. Commandos''', '''Condemned Vigilante''', '''Corrupted Touch''', '''Frozen Impact''', '''Oppressive Bombardment''', '''Shadowforge Tinkerer''' and '''Underworld Warden''' displaying their objectives Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v2.4.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|StoryModePI.png|Story Mode}} {{UpdateH1|Update Log:}} {{UpdateH2|[[Story Mode]] Introduced}} {{UpdateGreyText|Introducing [[Story Mode]]! We’re really excited to debut this to you all. Follow [[Commander]] and his crew as they navigate through the Tower Defense Simulator story. This is our first installment and its intention is to be a vehicle to introduce new players, and satisfy veteran fan’s desire for more story.}} {{UpdateWhiteText|In this first installment of Chapter 1, you’ll navigate 4 missions, one of which is a brand new map — which you can see below.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v2.4.0UpdateLog1.png}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Next Friday, we’ll drop the next installment: Missions 5 - 8 for you and your friends to venture through. We’re eager to see the loadouts and memories you all create in this mode, and you can expect news on Chapter 2 when that time comes.}} {{UpdateH2|New [[Matchmaking]] UI}} {{UpdateGreyText|We’ve introduced new [[Matchmaking]] UI to improve navigation and make queueing into your favorite game modes better. You can expect to see all modes displayed here, including the brand new [[Story Mode]]!}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v2.4.0UpdateLog2.png}} {{UpdateH2|New [[Main Lobby|Lobby]]}} {{UpdateGreyText|With [[Story Mode]], and the updated [[Matchmaking]] UI, we felt it was time to give the lobby a much-deserved overhaul. You’ll still see the things you know and love: [[Leaderboard]]s, event countdown timers, but if you venture around enough… you’ll find some hidden gems.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v2.4.0UpdateLog3.png}} {{UpdateH2|New Weekly Cadence}} {{UpdateGreyText|We’re excited to share that we’ll be moving to a weekly update schedule.}} {{UpdateWhiteText|This means you can expect new content, balance changes, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements on a much more consistent basis. While some weeks will naturally be larger than others, our goal is to keep delivering regular updates that continue to improve and expand the game.
We’re looking forward to sharing what’s next and can’t wait for you to see what we have in the weeks ahead.}} {{UpdateH1|Game Changes:}} *[[Story Mode]] includes new dialogue, cutscenes, mission progression, star objectives, suggested towers, first-clear rewards, and party-aware mission access. *The [[tutorial]] has been folded into [[Story Mode]] as an onboarding chapter with updated prompts, progression, and full tower refunds. *[[Story Mode]] triumphs are excluded from standard leaderboard win tracking. *Cutscene and dialogue systems received updates for story sequences, speaker presentation, subtitles, timing, and debugging tools. *Tower information, reward stats, hotbar behavior, objectives, and several lobby HUD elements received UI polish and fixes. *[[Elementalist]], enemy stats, story mission balance, and mission wave cash have received supporting adjustments. {{UpdateH1|Balance Changes:}} {{UpdateRebalance|DefaultOperatorIconIG.png|[[Operator]]|{{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Early Game Changes|Description = '''Tower Limit:''' {{Color|No|20 -> 16}} '''Level 0-1 Burst Cooldown:''' {{Color|Yes|1.5s -> 1.4s}} '''Level 2 Coordination Radius:''' {{Color|Yes|3.75 -> 4}} '''Level 3 Coordination Radius:''' {{Color|Yes|3.75 -> 4}}}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 4-6 Changes|Description = '''Level 4 Cost:''' {{Color|Yes|$2,575 -> $1,950}} '''Level 4 Damage:''' {{Color|Yes|5 -> 6}} '''Shared Optics:''' Moved from Level 4 to Level 5 '''Level 5 Cooldown:''' {{Color|Yes|0.17 -> 0.16}} '''Level 6 Cost:''' {{Color|No|$4,250 -> $7,000}} '''Level 6 Damage:''' {{Color|Yes|6 -> 10}} '''Level 6 Cooldown:''' {{Color|No|0.13 -> 0.16}}}}}} }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v2.4.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
